        append_data_to_structure(data_list, pkl_file)

    images_to_video(np.array(data_list["observation"]["head_camera"]["rgb"]), out_path=video_path)

    with h5py.File(hdf5_path, "w") as f:
        create_hdf5_from_dict(f, data_list)

offset_meaning: same-frame author-recorded drive target, followed by future frames
success_provenance: Collector admits planned/check_success seeds; data replay uses seed.txt and asserts check_success after collection. HDF5 has no explicit success flags.
cadence: Author dense-control recording every15 simulation steps plus boundary pictures; recorded frames are replayed in their original order as absolute drive targets. No claim of identical low-level wall-clock timing.
limitations: The pinned runtime source establishes the author convention; it is not an embedded generator commit in the public HDF5.
No original measured-qpos stream or separate commanded-next-state field exists in this archive.
Offset0 is the explicit same-frame/future-recorded-target objective; no guessed next-command shift.
Official loaded-motor inverse/delta/Normalize/padding roundtrip and complete physical replay of all12 are runtime gates before fitting.
No pickle was deserialized, model constructed, or robot action issued during this source review.
image_channel_contract: camera.get_rgba scales Color to uint8; get_rgb drops alpha without permutation. images_encoding passes native RGB arrays directly to cv2.imencode('.jpg'), with no swap. Matching cv2.imdecode(...,IMREAD_COLOR) restores the original native RGB channel order. PIL.convert('RGB') would swap native red and blue for these authored JPEGs.
